Can I enquire about Aari work for a bridal blouse?+

Yes. The boutique offers Aari work and bridal blouse customisation. Share your preferred design and saree details when you enquire.

How far ahead should I contact the boutique?+

Contact the boutique as early as you can with your wedding date. Availability and the time required depend on your design and are confirmed directly.
